description: Header file defining the JobQueue class and related classes for managing asynchronous job execution in the starboard::shared::starboard::player namespace.

classes.name: JobQueue
classes.description: Implements a thread-safe job queue allowing posting and execution of jobs on a dedicated thread.

classes.name: JobToken
classes.description: Represents a handle for a scheduled job, with validity checks.

classes.name: JobOwner
classes.description: Manages job scheduling and cancellation, associated with a specific JobQueue.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a job to run after a specified delay.

methods.name: ScheduleAndWait
methods.description: Schedules a job and blocks until it completes.

methods.name: RemoveJobByToken
methods.description: Removes a scheduled job identified by its token.

methods.name: StopSoon
methods.description: Signals the job queue to stop processing jobs soon.

methods.name: RunUntilStopped
methods.description: Runs the job processing loop until explicitly stopped.

methods.name: RunUntilIdle
methods.description: Runs jobs until the queue is idle.

methods.name: BelongsToCurrentThread
methods.description: Checks if the current thread owns the job queue.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current thread's JobQueue instance.
